newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid's general stock index hits key 600 level.
newsitem.headline: Madrid's general stock index hits key 600 level.

text.p: The Madrid general index was up 1.37 percent in late afternoon trade on Wednesday, breaking the key 600 level for the first time in its history.

Strength in banks, supermarkets and companies due to be included in the Ibex were fuelling the rise. Expectations of new fund flows into stocks next week when a special government debt issue matures is also pushing prices up, dealers said.
The Ibex-35 blue chip index was close to its new all-time high, rising 1.5 percent to 6,899.08. The intraday high set today was at 6,901.59.
